symptom: Default Trainer reported summed microbatch loss near 26 for gradient accumulation of 16, instead of mean loss near 1.6.
cause: RoBERTa forward accepts generic kwargs, so Trainer assumes its loss already accounts for num_items_in_batch; the model actually returns a per-microbatch mean CrossEntropyLoss.
fix: MultipleChoiceTrainer explicitly sets loss_is_scaled_for_ga=False so Trainer divides by the actual number of accumulation steps.
regression_check_after_fix: passed: accumulated loss and classifier gradient match the combined-batch reference
